supplements.title: A natural product-hybridization approach toward anticancer drug discovery: synthesis and antitumor evaluation of CTBC6, designed from sulforaphane and magnolol.
supplements.summary: CTBC6, a hybrid compound derived from natural products, effectively kills breast cancer cells by blocking key signaling pathways and targeting specific proteins.

supplements.title: Bioactive treatments against chronic myeloid leukemia from Hypericum lancasteri targeting p53 pathway.
supplements.summary: Plant compounds from Hypericum lancasteri kill chronic myeloid leukemia cells by activating the p53 cancer-fighting pathway.

supplements.title: UPLC-Q-TOF-MS/MS guided isolation of phyllanfranchins A-D, two pairs of undescribed cytotoxic dichapetalin hybrid triterpenoid epimers from Phyllanthus franchetianus.
supplements.summary: Researchers isolated four new plant compounds from Phyllanthus franchetianus that kill multiple cancer cell types, with one showing potent activity against lung cancer.

supplements.title: Neuroprotective effects of pepsin-hydrolyzed ovotransferrin on H2O2-induced oxidative damage in SH-SY5Y neuronal cells.
supplements.summary: Pepsin-processed egg white protein protects nerve cells from oxidative damage by reducing harmful molecules and preventing cell death.

supplements.title: Exercise training prior to and during cancer in mice preserves muscle mass, reduces tumour weight and suppresses molecular mediators of cachexia.
supplements.summary: Exercise before and during colon cancer preserves muscle mass, reduces tumor growth, and suppresses cancer-related muscle wasting in mice.

supplements.title: Autophagy activation by urolithin-a derivative UA-36 mitigates Friedreich's ataxia pathologies induced by frataxin deficiency.
supplements.summary: UA-36, a urolithin derivative, improves Friedreich's ataxia symptoms in mice by activating autophagy and restoring mitochondrial function.

supplements.title: In silico discovery of natural compounds from Vietnamese essential oils database with target binding to cancer-related proteins.
supplements.summary: Vietnamese essential oil compounds show promise against multiple cancer types through computational screening of cancer-related protein targets.

supplements.title: Baicalin attenuates angiotensin II-induced vascular endothelial injury via targeted activation of the Nrf2 signaling pathway: Integrated computational and in vitro evidence.
supplements.summary: Baicalin protects blood vessel cells from damage by activating Nrf2, a protective pathway that shields against oxidative stress.

supplements.title: α-Viniferin Induces Intrinsic Apoptosis in Triple-Negative Breast Cancer Cells and Synergizes With SB203580 Independently of p38 Mitogen-Activated Protein Kinase.
supplements.summary: A natural compound called α-viniferin kills triple-negative breast cancer cells and works better when combined with another drug.

supplements.title: α-Linolenic acid alleviates ovalbumin-induced allergic rhinitis in mice and modulates GPR120-NF-κB signaling.
supplements.summary: Alpha-linolenic acid reduces allergic rhinitis symptoms in mice by decreasing inflammation and blocking a key immune signaling pathway.

supplements.title: Esculentoside A suppresses the malignant progression of hepatocellular carcinoma by promoting RORB.
supplements.summary: Esculentoside A slows liver cancer growth by activating a protein called RORB that blocks cancer-promoting Wnt signaling.

supplements.title: Gambogic acid induces cell death via covalent binding with PRDX1 to regulate ER stress and autophagy.
supplements.summary: Gambogic acid, a natural compound in clinical trials, kills renal cancer cells by binding to a protein that triggers cell stress and death.

supplements.title: Efficacy and Mechanism of Silymarin Extract for Deep Second-Degree Burns in Rats.
supplements.summary: Silymarin extract promotes healing of deep second-degree burns in rats by reducing inflammation and supporting tissue repair.

supplements.title: Influence of formulation parameters on the physicochemical properties and cellular uptake of human serum albumin nanocarriers.
supplements.summary: Researchers optimized albumin nanoparticles for drug delivery to breast cancer cells, finding glutaraldehyde-crosslinked particles showed superior stability and enhanced cancer-fighting efficacy.

supplements.title: Novel benzophenones from the fibrous roots of Anemarrhena asphodeloides Bunge inhibit hepatocellular carcinoma activity by targeting ALDH3A1.
supplements.summary: Compounds from plant roots inhibit liver cancer cell growth by targeting a protein called ALDH3A1.

off_label.title: Targeting XIAP-coordinated PKC signaling resensitizes PD-1-refractory tumors for rechallenge.
off_label.summary: PKC inhibition resensitizes PD-1-resistant lung cancer to immunotherapy by reactivating immune cell killing and reducing tumor protection.

off_label.title: Unlocking the potential of TNF: From biologic agents to small-molecule inhibitors.
off_label.summary: Researchers are developing oral small-molecule TNF inhibitors to replace injectable biologics, offering better accessibility and lower costs for inflammatory disease treatment.

off_label.title: Nutrient stress-induced FTH1 safeguards redox balance and fuels pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma growth while serving as a therapeutic target and diagnostic biomarker.
off_label.summary: A protein called FTH1 helps pancreatic cancer cells survive nutrient stress, making it both a therapeutic target and a potential treatment response indicator.

off_label.title: Ivonescimab Plus Chemo Extends Squamous NSCLC Survival.
off_label.summary: Ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy significantly improves survival in advanced squamous lung cancer compared to standard immunotherapy.

off_label.title: ACY-1215 ameliorates experimental colitis by inhibiting dendritic cell maturation and Th1/Th17 responses.
off_label.summary: ACY-1215 reduces colitis by blocking immune cells from activating harmful inflammatory responses in the gut.

off_label.title: Colchicine attenuates kidney injury by modulating the NLRP3 inflammasome pathway.
off_label.summary: Colchicine reduces kidney damage in chronic kidney disease by turning off an inflammatory pathway called NLRP3.

off_label.title: Fluvoxamine and lycopene alleviate cisplatin-induced kidney fibrosis by modulating miR-21 and fibrotic signaling pathways.
off_label.summary: Fluvoxamine and lycopene protect kidneys from cisplatin chemotherapy damage by reducing inflammation, oxidative stress, and fibrosis in rats.

off_label.title: Ketone bodies as guardians of leukemic stemness through ferroptosis suppression.
off_label.summary: Leukemia stem cells use ketones to block a type of cell death, suggesting a new treatment target.

off_label.title: Impact of Beta-2 Adrenergic Blockade With Checkpoint Inhibition in Checkpoint Inhibitor Refractory Metastatic Triple Negative Breast Cancer
off_label.summary: Propranolol combined with pembrolizumab may help triple negative breast cancer patients who stopped responding to checkpoint inhibitor therapy.

off_label.title: A Single-Arm, Phase II Study of Autophagy Modulation Using Hydroxychloroquine in Combination With Encorafenib and Cetuximab or Panitumumab in Metastatic BRAF-mutated Colorectal Cancer Refractory to Standard Therapies
off_label.summary: Hydroxychloroquine added to standard drugs improved treatment outcomes for metastatic colorectal cancer with BRAF mutations resistant to prior therapies.

off_label.title: Phase I Study Evaluating Indomethacin in Combination With Platinum-based Chemotherapy
off_label.summary: Indomethacin combined with platinum-based chemotherapy is safe and may prevent drug resistance caused by immune cells in cancer patients.

off_label.title: M.globosa promotes lung cancer progression and M2 macrophage polarization through oxidative phosphorylation.
off_label.summary: M.globosa fungus promotes lung cancer growth by activating immune cells through a metabolic process that can be blocked by metformin.

off_label.title: Comprehensive multi-omics analysis identifies cancer subtypes and prognostic signatures of hepatitis B virus-associated hepatocellular carcinoma.
off_label.summary: Researchers identified two hepatocellular carcinoma subtypes and developed a prognostic tool that predicted outcomes better than existing models, revealing KX2-391 as a promising new treatment.

off_label.title: Calcium-modulated GJB6-GRHL3 positive feedback loop attenuates ESCC progression through AKT signaling pathway inhibition.
off_label.summary: GJB6 suppresses esophageal cancer growth by regulating a calcium-dependent feedback loop; AKT inhibitors may reverse this effect therapeutically.

off_label.title: HDAC inhibition reprograms stem cell fate to suppress infantile hemangioma vasculogenesis.
off_label.summary: HDAC inhibitors suppress infantile hemangioma growth by blocking stem cell differentiation into blood vessel-supporting cells.

biomarkers.title: RET fusion partners dictate oncogenic potential in undifferentiated spindle cell sarcomas.
biomarkers.summary: Different RET fusion partners in spindle cell sarcomas determine how aggressive the cancer becomes, offering targets for personalized treatment.

biomarkers.title: Dectin-1 signaling promotes Galectin-3 shedding and expansion of immunosuppressive CD71+ erythroid cells in breast cancer.
biomarkers.summary: PD-L1 blockade reduces immunosuppressive cells in triple-negative breast cancer by targeting Galectin-3-positive erythroid cells.

biomarkers.title: Normalized periprostatic adipose tissue thickness: an imaging marker associated with prostate biopsy outcomes among patients with PI-RADS and PSA double gray zone.
biomarkers.summary: Normalized periprostatic adipose tissue thickness on MRI better predicts prostate cancer than PSA density in diagnostically uncertain patients.

biomarkers.title: Multi-omics integration reveals convergent extracellular matrix remodelling and lipid metabolic reprogramming as central axes of adipocyte differentiation from mouse embryonic stem cells.
biomarkers.summary: Study identifies two key processes—extracellular matrix remodeling and lipid metabolism—that drive fat cell development from embryonic stem cells.

biomarkers.title: A signal-responsive cooperative transcription factor network determines alveolar macrophage identity.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers found that RXR proteins cooperate with other transcription factors to establish alveolar macrophage identity through tissue signals.

biomarkers.title: Systemic radionuclide treatments in gastro-entero-pancreatic neuroendocrine tumours.
biomarkers.summary: Radioactive peptide therapy is now a key treatment for advanced stomach and pancreatic neuroendocrine tumors, with recent trials expanding its effectiveness.

biomarkers.title: From dose to exposure? rethinking fluoropyrimidines as immune checkpoint partners in gastrointestinal cancers.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers propose switching from high-dose to continuous low-dose fluoropyrimidines to better combine chemotherapy with immunotherapy for gastrointestinal cancers.

biomarkers.title: Pilot study: prognostic significance of semi-quantitative parameters in baseline fluorine‑18 fluorodeoxyglucose PET/computed tomography in nonmetastatic breast cancer patients.
biomarkers.summary: Spleen activity measurements on PET scans may help predict outcomes in nonmetastatic breast cancer patients.

biomarkers.title: Unveiling intratumoral heterogeneity and isocitrate dehydrogenase status in gliomas: a simultaneous fluorine-18 fluorodeoxyglucose PET/MRI study based on 2021 WHO classification.
biomarkers.summary: PET/MRI imaging can help predict IDH mutation status and characterize tumor diversity in gliomas.

biomarkers.title: Targeting XIAP-coordinated PKC signaling resensitizes PD-1-refractory tumors for rechallenge.
biomarkers.summary: PKC inhibition resensitizes PD-1-resistant lung cancer to immunotherapy by reactivating immune cell killing and reducing tumor protection.

biomarkers.title: Antibody E06 and the Role of Oxidized Phospholipids in Atherogenesis and Inflammation.
biomarkers.summary: Antibody E06 neutralizes oxidized phospholipids, reducing inflammation and tissue damage across cardiovascular and liver diseases in animal models.

biomarkers.title: Am80-lipid nanoparticles serve as an enteric mucosal adjuvant following parenteral immunization with inactivated polio vaccine.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed nanoparticles containing Am80 that boost gut immunity when given with polio vaccine, enhancing protective intestinal antibodies.

biomarkers.title: Monoclonal antibodies targeting PCDH7 inhibit tumor growth and enhance immune responses in KRAS-mutant non-small cell lung cancer.
biomarkers.summary: Antibodies targeting PCDH7 shrink KRAS-mutant lung tumors and boost immune responses in preclinical models.

biomarkers.title: Advanced nanomedicines to target prostate cancer cells: emerging molecular tools and future clinical prospects.
biomarkers.summary: Nanomedicines using targeted nanoparticles offer precise, effective treatment for prostate cancer with multiple therapeutic approaches combined.

biomarkers.title: From stiffness-softness paradox to drug delivery systems: mechanical properties and regulation in tumor progression.
biomarkers.summary: Tumor tissue stiffness and cancer cell softness drive progression; drug delivery systems targeting these mechanical properties offer new treatment strategies.

trials.title: Pre-implementation factors for Active Music Engagement (AME): barriers and facilitators to integrating an evidence-based dyadic intervention into pediatric oncology care.
trials.summary: Music engagement intervention reduces distress in pediatric cancer patients and parents, with barriers and facilitators identified for hospital integration.

trials.title: Exploring meaning in culture: Insights from meaning-centered psychotherapy in Aotearoa, New Zealand.
trials.summary: Meaning-centered psychotherapy helps Indigenous cancer patients in New Zealand find purpose and improves their well-being during treatment.

trials.title: Disseminated infection caused by Mycobacterium sherrisii in an HIV-negative patient from China: A case report and literature review.
trials.summary: Researchers documented a rare bacterial infection caused by Mycobacterium sherrisii in an HIV-negative patient, highlighting diagnostic and treatment challenges.

trials.title: Dectin-1 signaling promotes Galectin-3 shedding and expansion of immunosuppressive CD71+ erythroid cells in breast cancer.
trials.summary: PD-L1 blockade reduces immunosuppressive cells in triple-negative breast cancer by targeting Galectin-3-positive erythroid cells.

trials.title: Systemic radionuclide treatments in gastro-entero-pancreatic neuroendocrine tumours.
trials.summary: Radioactive peptide therapy is now a key treatment for advanced stomach and pancreatic neuroendocrine tumors, with recent trials expanding its effectiveness.

trials.title: From dose to exposure? rethinking fluoropyrimidines as immune checkpoint partners in gastrointestinal cancers.
trials.summary: Researchers propose switching from high-dose to continuous low-dose fluoropyrimidines to better combine chemotherapy with immunotherapy for gastrointestinal cancers.

trials.title: Pilot study: prognostic significance of semi-quantitative parameters in baseline fluorine‑18 fluorodeoxyglucose PET/computed tomography in nonmetastatic breast cancer patients.
trials.summary: Spleen activity measurements on PET scans may help predict outcomes in nonmetastatic breast cancer patients.

trials.title: In situ proteomics unveils specialized domains for extrasynaptic signaling on neuronal cilia.
trials.summary: Neuronal cilia function as specialized signaling hubs with organized nanodomains that detect neurotransmitters from nearby synapses, enhancing brain cell communication.

trials.title: Am80-lipid nanoparticles serve as an enteric mucosal adjuvant following parenteral immunization with inactivated polio vaccine.
trials.summary: Researchers developed nanoparticles containing Am80 that boost gut immunity when given with polio vaccine, enhancing protective intestinal antibodies.

trials.title: Monoclonal antibodies targeting PCDH7 inhibit tumor growth and enhance immune responses in KRAS-mutant non-small cell lung cancer.
trials.summary: Antibodies targeting PCDH7 shrink KRAS-mutant lung tumors and boost immune responses in preclinical models.

trials.title: Advanced nanomedicines to target prostate cancer cells: emerging molecular tools and future clinical prospects.
trials.summary: Nanomedicines using targeted nanoparticles offer precise, effective treatment for prostate cancer with multiple therapeutic approaches combined.

trials.title: Efficacy of a site-specific anti-Nectin-4 antibody-drug conjugate against Nectin-4-positive triple-negative breast cancer models.
trials.summary: A new anti-Nectin-4 antibody drug shows promise against triple-negative breast cancer, though it requires further optimization for improved effectiveness.

trials.title: Peptide modified lipid nanoparticles Co-Delivering IL-12 mRNA and PD-L1 siRNA for glioblastoma immunotherapy.
trials.summary: Peptide-modified nanoparticles delivering two immunotherapy agents crossed the blood-brain barrier to treat glioblastoma more effectively.

trials.title: Novel staurosporine-type indolocarbazole glycoalkaloids as potent and selective FLT3-ITD inhibitors for acute myeloid leukemia.
trials.summary: Researchers developed a new drug compound that effectively blocks a mutated protein driving acute myeloid leukemia, showing promise for treatment.

trials.title: Utilization of next generation sequencing from glioma patient liquid biopsy to determine survival prognostics: A systematic review.
trials.summary: Next-generation sequencing of blood samples can predict glioma survival outcomes by measuring tumor DNA levels, but standardized methods are still needed.
